comment: The LOOP jack is a level, not a trigger: BWAVPCore.cc:330-331 invert the button's setting for as long as the jack is high, so looping goes back to the button when the jack falls. The maker's manual says 'a trigger or rising edge of a gate on this jack toggles looping mode', which describes a different behaviour. The outputs are 5V peak (BWAVPCore.cc:92-93 and 67-68), not the 8V most of this plugin uses. Seven of the nine parameters are alt parameters with no panel widget (BWAVP_info.hh:22-28), so they appear only on the right-click menu.
